name: General Motors
notes: operatingIncome = GM's reported 'Operating income (loss)' (total net sales and revenue less total costs and expenses; equity income, interest expense on automotive debt and non-operating income below it) for 2005-2008 (old GM, CIK 40730) and 2010+ (New GM, CIK 1467858). Old GM's 2000-2004 statements have no such line, so those five years are derived (quality estimated) on the same definition: Automotive and Other Operations net sales less total costs and expenses plus Financing and Insurance Operations (GMAC) revenues less total costs and expenses, leaving out automotive interest expense. 2009 omitted (predecessor/successor split). Discontinuities: GMAC is consolidated through November 2006 (2005 and 2006 revenue include it) and its equity result sits below operating income afterwards; 2000-2001 include Hughes (FY2002 10-K); 2012 includes the 27.1bn Opel/Vauxhall goodwill impairment; 2017+ restated excluding Opel/Vauxhall (2016 and earlier include it); 2010 as presented in the FY2012 10-K.
